# Devnet receipts

Real EIP-8141 frame transactions authorised by JARDIN hash-based signatures (no ECDSA), submitted through the ERC-8421 alt-mempool sidecar. Regenerate with `python -m pqv.receipts public local`.

- chain id: 1337

### Why the ERC-8421 alt mempool (recorded node responses)

The vault's VERIFY frame reads the shared LeafLedger (storage not associated with the sender).

| submission | admitted | node response |
|---|---|---|
| staked PQ-Vault → ethrex canonical mempool (`eth_sendRawTransaction`) | False | `{"code": -32000, "message": "Invalid params: Frame transaction validation-prefix simulation failed: StorageReadNonSender"}` |
| unstaked vault → ERC-8421 alt mempool | False | `{"message": "unstaked payer accessed 0x15c9a7285c8c45881616a7986f1303199e1bde23 slot 0xebdb6a0794a3a1bda46243385d9651b234005c10304a2363163d240737fff062", "data": {"payer": "0x5884d4d5588321049aD61cE6Dd6518F5127168F1"}, "code": -32502}` |
| staked PQ-Vault → ERC-8421 alt mempool | True | transactions 1-5 above |
